categories.name: p2p
categories.evidence: Touches peer message processing and orphan handling with the 'P2P' label.
categories.rationale: Limits orphan transaction reconsideration to one validation attempt per message-processing turn to avoid stalling peer message handling. As cited in the description regarding CVE-2024-52914, uninterruptible orphan processing presents a CPU DoS and latency hazard across peers, making message-loop granularity a notable robustness improvement.
